question: What relationship does the Nestlé sentence add when it connects historical assessments to an ongoing priority?
pattern: The generated wording is “Our development priority remains moving beyond individual site assessments”. The 2021 visible source supports a “more comprehensive and systematic approach” to risks, including animal welfare. The diagnostic rationale disputes the link to earlier site assessments and its status as a continuing priority in target year 2022.
meaning: The distinctive change is relational and temporal: individually sourced ideas are joined into one continuing-development narrative. The source does contain a forward-looking expansion in approach, so this is subtler than inventing an unrelated topic. The blocks identify exactly which continuity claim needs review.
limits: The displayed card does not include all earlier assessment material; the complete bundle contains that context. The automatic conflation label is not independently established by this plate, and one case does not quantify how often such linking is unjustified.
